test_plot_run: test the plot_run function to generate a plotly Figure from TORAX output files and a plot configuration
test_plot_run_from_data_tree: test the plot_run_from_data_tree function to generate a plotly Figure from in-memory xarray DataTrees
test_load_data: test the load_data function to load TORAX output .nc files into a PlotData object with unit transformations
test_PlotData: test the PlotData class to access TORAX simulation variables as attributes with derived properties like chi_total_i and P_sink
test_FigureProperties: test the FigureProperties class to configure subplot grid layout and validate axis count against rows times columns
test_PlotProperties: test the PlotProperties dataclass to configure individual subplot attributes, labels, and plot type
test_PlotType: test the PlotType enum to distinguish between SPATIAL and TIME_SERIES plot types
